verdict.rationale: SendGrid's Inbound Parse webhook is a first-party feature that parses incoming email, including attachments, and POSTs the data to a URL of your choice. That covers the 'POST to an endpoint' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows rule-based routing: no matching on recipient or pattern, no sending different matches to different endpoints, and no forward or store actions. Missing for 10: rule/pattern matching on recipient, routing to multiple distinct endpoints per rule, forward and store actions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route inbound mail with rules — match on recipient or pattern and forward, store, or POST to different endpoints

citations.quote: The Inbound Parse webhook parses the contents and attachments for incoming email to a email server, then send that data to a URL of your choice.
